text_block_list.text:
It happened on the way back from an outing 
with T.M. Opera O...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, framed by the fiery twilight sun, I 
radiate even more brilliantly than ever 
before..."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: And yet! Just look around, Trainer-kun!

Looking around the station area, people 
who appeared to be heading home from work 
were walking by with tired faces.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Kh, what a heartbreaking sight...! To 
think the people are hanging their heads 
when the Supreme Ruler is right here!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-kun, I've decided. We shall 
stage an opera here!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
With my radiance full of affection, I'll 
replenish the parched springs in 
everyone's hearts!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Starring me, co-starring Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Of course! You are my Trainer... Together, 
we aim to make the stage a success, do we 
not?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, the 'Twilight Opera O Theater' 
—shall make its gorgeously brilliant 
debut!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, passersby on the street~♪ Why do you 
look so down~?

T.M. Opera O shoots me a look, as if 
urging me to continue. In that case—
choice_data_list: I'll have to sing with T.M. Opera O!
I'll have to dance with T.M. Opera O!

text_block_list.text:
Mustering up my courage, I decided to sing 
along with her.
choice_data_list:
La-la-la~ Lost on this journey called 
life~♪

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Then look up, look up~♪ And see how 
dazzlingly bright I shine~♪

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: I am your light~♪ I am your guiding star~♪

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"When times are tough, look at me~♪ When 
you're feeling lost, look at me too~♪"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I'll solve everything for you~♪ And why is 
that, you ask~?
choice_data_list:
O-O great "Overlord of the End of the 
Century"~♪

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That's right, I am the radiance that 
lights up the world~♪

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: T... M... âª Opera... Ooooooo~âª

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And with that, the curtains close on "The 
Opera O Theater."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
However, my existence should now be deeply 
etched into your hearts—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
When times get tough, I want you to 
remember me! I'm always watching over 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Passersby
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaah...! *clap clap clap*...!

text_block_list.name: Male Passerby
text_block_list.text:
I don't really understand, but seeing her 
brimming with confidence like that... 
filled me with energy!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Alright, guess I'll push through a bit 
more! Thanks, ladies!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Looks like everyone managed to get their 
energy back!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! As expected of myself! The sun 
that illuminates the hearts of all 
mankind!

While her eccentric behavior never ceases 
to amaze, I was reminded once again of 
T.M. Opera O's wondrous charm.

I decided to dance while recalling T.M. 
Opera O's dance lessons.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oh! Not bad at all, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: I can't afford to lose either! Toh!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Graceful like a swan...! Powerful like a 
great eagle...!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Let us dance together to become the beacon 
of hope for all people!

text_block_list.name: Male Passerby
text_block_list.text:
I don't really get it, but... now I really 
feel like moving my body!

text_block_list.name: Female Passerby
text_block_list.text:
"Watching that dance, I feel like I've 
gotten some energy back!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it looks like people have gotten 
their energy back!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, I was surprised! To think you 
could keep up with my dancing all the way 
to the end!"
choice_data_list:
I was trying so hard I don't really 
remember, though...

I was trying so hard I don't really 
remember, though...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
This is also thanks to having my existence 
burned into your eyes every single day—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Continue to burn my image into your eyes, 
and let your talent blossom to the 
fullest!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
No need to hold back! Come on, bring it 
on!!

Afterward, an "Opera O Appreciation 
Gathering" was held, once again drawing 
the gaze of passersby.

While her eccentric behavior never ceases 
to amaze, I was reminded once again of 
T.M. Opera O's wondrous charm.
